legend: dev = status reported by the module agent after its own typecheck/lint/test/build/screenshots/e2e; orchestrator integration verification is tracked in PROJECT_STATUS.md

rows.name: Admin shell (sidebar, topbar, command palette, role-based "no permission" state)
rows.note: Verified at 1440/1280/768/390. Shell, sidebar, topbar, ⌘K palette, approvals inbox and no-permission (access table by module, lock state on groups). Approval policy and Export CSV buttons omitted (no API). The palette searches pages and players, not transactions or rounds.

rows.name: Admin Login + 2FA + session timeout
rows.note: Implemented: two-step sign-in with one login call, a generic error that never says which part failed, locked state (lockout after 5 attempts), session ended after idle/revoked/max length, 15-minute idle timeout with a real countdown, re-authentication. Missing: security-key (WebAuthn) and 'trust this device' (no API support); the 'network not approved' state is a dev preview only because the API has no IP allow-list.

rows.name: Overview (all KPIs + system health) (M)
rows.note: Verified 1440/1280/768/390 with real ledger KPIs. Deviations: no deltas or sparklines (the API has no previous-period data); Gross revenue replaced by Customer balances (games are simulations, no GGR); a 'Last 30 days' label instead of a 24h/7d switch; KYC panel shows pending and verified counts only; system health = DB, Redis, queues, randomness, ledger invariants, kill switches. Roles without ledger.read and without withdrawals.approve (e.g. Support) get the money panels left out, not blurred.

rows.name: KYC Queue + review detail (M)
rows.note: Queue (KPIs, status/level filters, SLA, risk, decision rules, recent decisions) and review (checks, masked player, risk meter, limits, history, approve / reject / request info with reason + 2FA). Playwright e2e passes. Deviations: decision uses buttons plus a dialog instead of inline radios; no document images (the provider keeps them); no case assignment.

rows.name: AML Alerts (M)
rows.note: KPIs (open, closed 7 days, no-issue rate 30 days), filters, table, full-width preview (why it fired, risk score, next step: escalate / close / dismiss via the existing resolve endpoint, withdrawal hold links to User Management restrictions), bottom sheet on mobile.

rows.name: Deposits
rows.note: /admin/finance/deposits — matches Figma layout: KPIs, network watchers, search/network/status filters, activity table, selected-deposit detail, held-deposits panel, CSV export. Checked at 1440 and 390. Watchers show 'No RPC (DEMO)' because no testnet RPC is configured. No 'Network health' button.

rows.name: Withdrawals queue + detail (controlled approve/reject, four-eyes) (M)
rows.note: Queue and WD detail, close to Figma. Includes queue card, tab views with counts, risk bars, SLA watch, policy FIN-2.3, approve step 1/2 then second approver, reject with reason + 2FA, sticky mobile action bar and bottom sheet. Bulk approve and 'Ask user for info' are deliberately not built. Approve/reject are API e2e-tested (existing admin tests) but not clicked through in the Playwright run.

rows.name: Platform Fees
rows.note: Fee rule, 30-day bar chart with table toggle, check that the fee sub-ledger matches the fees account, fees by round. Platform fees of cancelled rounds are shown as retained (see decisions).

rows.name: Pool Accounting
rows.note: Liabilities hero (pool escrow + owed prizes + refunds), ledger check using the custody mirror because no RPC is configured, round waterfall, ledger accounts, rounds ledger, Immutable panel.

rows.name: Financial Ledger (append-only)
rows.note: Integrity banner (7/7 append-only triggers, sum of the ledger = 0, journal digest, audit chain verified), journal table with prev→hash per journal, 'How the hash chain works', Corrections panel. The chain hash is recomputed on read; there is no on-chain anchoring and no correcting-entry workflow.

rows.name: Reconciliation (match/mismatch)
rows.note: Live scopes (ledger total, posting balance, fee/pool/owed/locked sub-ledgers, round pools, custody, in-flight deposits) with match/mismatch/pending, problems first, Run now, CSV. Missing: stored run history (24 h squares), the investigation (INV) panel and the correcting-entry proposal. They need tables and a workflow that do not exist.

rows.name: Refunds
rows.note: Cancelled-round panels (threshold bars, claimed vs outstanding, largest unclaimed), remind-players action (reason, audited, 1 per 24 h), 'Issue manual refund' disabled, returns that are not refunds.

rows.name: Revenue Reports
rows.note: Gross (platform fees) − rewards = net, period chips, weekly bar chart, product share, statement tied to ledger sources, excluded network fees. No game revenue (games are non-monetary simulations) and no scheduled reports.

rows.name: Export CSV (modal + states)
rows.note: Export CSV dialog with Configure / Generating / Ready (rows, SHA-256, expiry, audit #) / Error (too many rows) states. Personal-data switch gated by permission, reason counter, watermark. No column selection and no row estimate.

rows.name: Pool Overview
rows.note: KPIs, round panel with server-clock countdown, 4-stat strip, required disclaimer (fee line, 'You can lose your stake', 18+), lifecycle, pipeline health, needs attention, recent rounds, Immutable chips.

rows.name: "Immutable by design" policy panel / circuit-breaker (dual approval)
rows.note: Contract decides / Admins may / Nobody can; breaker with rules, current state, request / second-approval / decline dialogs, history, governance. Dual control is API e2e-tested (requester, self-block, same-role block, approve, entries return 503, resume). No 'Download policy (PDF)' and no contract card.

rows.name: Pool Balance
rows.note: Where the money is, hourly pool growth, latest pool movements, ledger vs projection per active round. Contract balance not read (DEMO, no RPC).

rows.name: Active Round (monitoring) (M)
rows.note: Live countdown, thresholds, entries per hour, prize table at the current pool, purchase feed, concentration.

rows.name: Historical Rounds
rows.note: Paginated history with status filter and settlement/refund progress.

rows.name: Participant List
rows.note: Round picker (?round=), participants grouped by player (entries, stake, fees, share, entry IDs, KYC, country), search.

rows.name: Prize Distribution
rows.note: Split bars and winners table with claim status; read-only.

rows.name: VRF Status
rows.note: Provider config, counts, request table, honest empty state (the dev DB has no randomness requests). No LINK subscription balance. The fulfilled and delayed states are data-driven and not visually checked.

rows.name: Settlement Status
rows.note: Allocations, settlement steps and postings for settled rounds. No auto-claim batch progress (the backend credits Owed in one transaction). DEMO history rounds have only 1 winner row and no claim rows.

rows.name: Refund Status
rows.note: Reuses the refund panels (RefundOnCancel), filter by ?round=.

rows.name: Admin Roles
rows.note: Live role cards: permission counts, sensitive permissions, members, pending change requests.

rows.name: Permissions matrix
rows.note: Live matrix with policy chips. Super Admin can stage changes for one role at a time and submit them as a four-eyes request (reason + 2FA); the Super Admin role itself is fixed. Read-only for everyone else.

rows.name: Audit Logs
rows.note: Verified 1440/1280/768/390. Integrity banner (GET /admin/audit-logs/verify), filters, expandable rows. Page-based pagination instead of cursor.

rows.name: Users List
rows.note: KPIs, filters (search, status, KYC level, restricted), table with masked email, KYC, status, AML risk, country, ledger balance and last active, pagination, cards below 768. No saved views or CSV export.

rows.name: Audit History
rows.note: Audit table filtered to the player; rows expand to hashes and metadata.

rows.name: User Profile (summary)
rows.note: Header with identity, badges and the read-only 5-column balances strip; 9 tabs (a section picker below 1024); two-column summary. 'Add case note' and 'Export user data' omitted (no API).

rows.name: Account Details
rows.note: Implemented: masked email, date of birth and last IP, each revealed one field at a time with a logged reason (shown for 60 s, value not stored in the audit log); account facts, consents (read-only), security, sessions table. Missing: legal name, phone, address and nationality (no data), the support-context panel, and end-session / 2FA-reset actions (no API).

rows.name: Wallet Addresses
rows.note: Wallets with whitelist, cool-down and removed states, usage counts, deposit addresses, read-only notice. 'Flag for review' omitted (no API).

rows.name: KYC Status
rows.note: Three-level tracker, records table, limits by level. No documents table or 'Request information' (the mock provider has no documents and there is no API).

rows.name: AML Risk
rows.note: Rule-based read-only score with bands, factor breakdown and alerts table. No 90-day chart (no score history is stored).

rows.name: Transaction History
rows.note: Lifetime flows, type filter, paginated table with separate platform-fee and network-fee columns, append-only note.

rows.name: Account Restrictions (apply/lift with reason + 2FA)
rows.note: Verified 1440/1280/768/390 plus e2e. Apply dialog per Figma: restriction select, what changes for the user, reason category, internal reason, 2FA, four-eyes notice for holds and suspensions. Lift = reason + 2FA. Pending requests, history, policy panels, what the player sees. No duration option (the API has no timed restrictions).

rows.name: Responsible Gaming Status
rows.note: Limits with meters (decimal maths, never floats), pending increases, self-exclusion and history, 'admins cannot loosen' notice. No play-pattern or harm-marker analytics.

rows.name: Four-eyes approval modal + confirm-with-reason + re-auth pattern
rows.note: Confirm-with-reason, request submitted with AR reference and audit entry, second-approver review, self-approval blocked, approved/rejected/withdrawn/expired trail, captured during e2e. Deviation: the fresh 2FA code is entered in the decision dialog and checked with that same call, instead of a separate pre-verified step (codes are single-use and only valid for 30 s). No 'remind approvers'.

rows.name: Register (email + password)
rows.note: Sign-up runs through Privy (email, then 6-digit code; Google/Apple; wallet). The Figma register fields moved to /onboarding: handle, country, date of birth, and the 2 required consents plus optional marketing, all unchecked. No password: owner decision #3. Screenshots and e2e done.

rows.name: Register — wallet-first
rows.note: Wallet-first sign-up view with the 6 provider rows, seed-phrase notice and 18+ / jurisdiction line. Browser wallet is fully custom (SIWE); WalletConnect / Coinbase / Trust / Phantom / Ledger open Privy's themed modal in real Privy mode. DEV MOCK simulates the connection.

rows.name: Login
rows.note: Sign-in view: Welcome back, email, 'Sign in', Google/Apple, 4 wallet quick-connect tiles, anti-phishing note. No password, 'keep me signed in' or 'forgot password' under Privy; the locked state is Privy's too-many-attempts.

rows.name: Email Verification
rows.note: Code step: Step 2 of 3 bar, 6-box code field, 60 s resend cooldown, sent/expires times, wrong code with attempts left (5), expired / locked, success with next steps leading to onboarding. Screenshots 1440/390 and e2e.

rows.name: Forgot Password
rows.note: Password reset does not apply to players under Privy.

rows.name: 2FA Enrollment
rows.note: /2fa/setup: scan (QR from the real otpauth URI plus a grouped setup key), confirm against the API, 10 backup codes (download / copy / print, Finish disabled until the box is ticked). e2e enrols with a real TOTP code.

rows.name: 2FA Challenge (login / withdrawal)
rows.note: useStepUp() / StepUpDialog / /2fa/challenge: anti-phishing code, authenticator or backup code, wrong code with attempts left, 15-minute lock with a countdown to the real unlock time, 'set up 2FA first'. The withdrawal variant matches Figma; the login variant doesn't apply (player login is Privy).

rows.name: Connect Wallet modal
rows.note: Connect-wallet dialog: list, WalletConnect QR (DEMO), connecting, rejected, wrong network (switch to Arbitrum), success leading to verify. Exposed as useWalletConnect().

rows.name: Wallet Verification (sign message)
rows.note: Verify-ownership dialog: readable message, 'No transaction / No gas · 0.00 / Can't move funds' chips, 10-minute message with live countdown, success record, rejected, expired. Privy uses useLinkWithSiwe; DEV MOCK shows a neutral mock wallet pop-up. Re-syncs the API session afterwards.

rows.name: KYC Intro & levels
rows.note: KYC intro and levels: current level, daily limits, the next level's requirements, and Start Level N. Higher levels open only in order.

rows.name: KYC Personal Details
rows.note: Personal details form with kycDetailsSchema. All errors show at once in an error summary: 18+, per-country postal format, last-name initials, PEP choice, an accuracy checkbox that starts unchecked. Country must match the account and be permitted. Details carry over to later levels.

rows.name: KYC Document Upload
rows.note: Document upload: choose the type, requirements, front and back. Only metadata and a SHA-256 hash (computed in the browser) are sent. The mock check fails files under 40 KB as too blurry so they can be retaken. Previews, and 'We read these details from your document' with the document number masked.

rows.name: KYC Liveness / Selfie
rows.note: Mock liveness check: camera via getUserMedia, a 'Camera permission is off' state, and 'Use DEMO capture (no camera)'. Up to 3 attempts, then manual review. Partial: the desktop hand-off to a phone by QR code is not built.

rows.name: KYC Pending
rows.note: Review and submit (confirmation not pre-checked), then the pending screen: reference number, expected time, and DEMO approve/reject controls for the mock provider. Submitting creates a notification and an audit row.

rows.name: KYC Approved
rows.note: Approved screen with the new daily limit. Level 1 is approved instantly by the mock provider and offers 'Continue to Level 2'.

rows.name: KYC Rejected
rows.note: Rejected screen: failed checks with what to fix ('We couldn't verify your ID yet', Fix and resubmit). The resubmit step asks only for the items that failed (liveness is kept), then 'Submit again'.

rows.name: Restricted Account
rows.note: /restricted/{suspended,under-review,self-excluded,region} use live data from the new GET /auth/account-status plus /wallet/balances; loading, error and not-restricted states included. Uses the normal casino shell, not Figma's reduced restricted-mode shell.

rows.name: Session expired / re-auth modal
rows.note: Session-expired modal after 30 min idle or any 401; 'Sign in again' returns to the same page; 'nothing changed' reassurance. The 'sensitive action re-auth' variant is covered by StepUpDialog (no player passwords).

rows.name: New-device login alert
rows.note: API flags sign-ins from a device label the player never used; the alert shows on their other sessions with 'Yes, it was me' / 'No, secure my account' (signs out all other sessions, audited). e2e passes across 2 browser contexts.

rows.name: Anti-Phishing Code
rows.note: Anti-phishing code: view (masked), set or change via step-up, and a preview of how emails show it.

rows.name: Security Settings (security score)
rows.note: Security score from GET /me/security: a 0-100 score from six weighted items, a status, devices to review, a next-step hint, sign-in and withdrawal protection, and recent events. The Figma 'Password' row is replaced by 'Sign-in method: passwordless (Privy)', following the owner decision.

rows.name: Two-Factor Authentication mgmt
rows.note: 2FA manage page. Move to a new phone or reset (step-up, then the auth agent's /2fa/setup enrolment). Turn off (confirm dialog, then step-up). Generate backup codes (step-up; codes shown once with download, copy and an 'I've saved them' checkbox). Uses the auth agent's useStepUp.

rows.name: KYC Status
rows.note: KYC status page: a summary for each state, verified details, review timeline, fix card and level cards. The flow opens as a dialog at /account/kyc/verify. Partial: no expired-ID state, because the API does not track document expiry.

rows.name: Verification Documents
rows.note: Documents list from GET /kyc/documents: items with status counts, older verified records, and an empty state.

rows.name: Login History
rows.note: Login history from GET /me/login-history: All/Successful/Flagged/Ended filters, day range, paging, a table on desktop and cards on mobile, CSV export. The flagged banner uses devicesToReview from /me/security.

rows.name: Connected Devices
rows.note: Devices page: sessions grouped by device, with revoke, 'sign out other sessions' and show-all. Partial: the device-trust duration select and the '2FA on every sign-in' toggle are left out because the API does not enforce them; an info card stands in their place.

rows.name: Session Management
rows.note: Sessions page: active sessions and ended ones from the last 90 days, the current browser marked, revoke one or all others. Partial: the inactivity timeout is shown read-only from IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.

rows.name: Notification Preferences
rows.note: Notification preferences: an email/push/in-app grid across 11 categories. Locked categories show 'Required'. Marketing is opt-in only. Reset to recommended and quiet hours. Saved with PUT /me/notification-preferences, stored in UserProfile.preferences.

rows.name: Deposits
rows.note: Deposits: KPIs, filterable list with confirmations, empty state for a new account.

rows.name: Withdrawals
rows.note: Withdrawals: under-review tracker with fee breakdown (network fee separate, platform fee 0.00), daily-limit meter, list.

rows.name: Fees
rows.note: Fees: entries × 0.05 equation, current round / 30 d KPIs, fee lines (platform vs network), fee schedule.

rows.name: Rewards
rows.note: Rewards: owed reward card with claim (POST /wallet/owed/claim), KPIs, list.

rows.name: Refunds
rows.note: Refunds: owed refund card with timeline + claim, KPIs, list, how refunds work (states that fees are not refunded under current rules).

rows.name: Complete Transaction History + export
rows.note: Balance + KPIs, search/type/status/period filters, table ≥1024 / cards <1024, expandable details, pagination, CSV export (audited), print. No 'Your exports' list.

rows.name: My Games
rows.note: In-progress round with real countdown + odds, last-30-day KPIs (Global Pool vs simulation kept separate), recently played (DEMO simulation sessions).

rows.name: My Entries
rows.note: KPIs, status filters, sort, entries grouped by round, empty state, what-each-status-means cards. Grouped by round rather than per-entry expandable rows.

rows.name: My Active Rounds
rows.note: Active round cards with countdown, entries, share, empty state.

rows.name: My Results
rows.note: Settled/cancelled rounds with result badges and verify links.

rows.name: My Winnings (claim/settlement)
rows.note: Owed vs settled prizes, refunds and rewards, claim to Available.

rows.name: Game History
rows.note: Game rounds with commit-reveal seeds (server seed hidden until the session ends), game filter, CSV export; simulation notice.

rows.name: Favorites
rows.note: Favourites grid with remove (heart), empty state; API add/remove.

rows.name: RG Hub / overview
rows.note: Hub: session bar, 6 tool cards, need-a-pause cards, help resources, limit rules; mobile list + today card. Verified 1440/390 vs Figma 121:54556 / 129:57449.

rows.name: Deposit Limits
rows.note: Limit setter (period, input, usage, pending increase/removal, cancel), pending notice, deposits counted this week, limit history from the audit log. Matches Figma 121:56097.

rows.name: Participation Limits
rows.note: Participation and loss limits, what-counts card (0.05 USDT fee per entry), today-at-a-glance.

rows.name: Time Limits
rows.note: Daily time limit, session-length limit, quiet hours (UTC), all enforced by the API; when-time-is-up card.

rows.name: Reality Checks (settings + popup)
rows.note: Interval chips, pause/push toggles, live preview, recent reminders; reality-check popup mounted app-wide (dialog ≥768, bottom sheet <768), no close icon. Push sending not implemented.

rows.name: Cooling-Off Period
rows.note: Choose (nothing pre-selected), confirm dialog/sheet, active banner + withdraw card; API cooling-off endpoint; cannot be shortened. Shell top-bar Deposit not disabled (shared shell).

rows.name: Self-Exclusion
rows.note: 4 steps + active state work end to end. Departures: step 3 uses step-up TOTP (only when 2FA is on) + typed SELF-EXCLUDE + unchecked acknowledgement instead of a password; open entries stay in their round (design says refunded); shell promo/Deposit hiding not done.

rows.name: Wallet Overview (balance breakdown: available/locked/pending/owed)
rows.note: Overview from GET /wallet/balances: Available/Locked/Pending/Owed with share bar, composition lines and glossary dialog. Withdrawable-now card with daily limit meter (GET /wallet/status), quick actions, in-progress list, recent activity, lifetime totals, networks strip, deposit-limit banners. Loading skeletons and error state. Empty state (zero balance and no transactions) is implemented but was not screenshotted with a real empty account. Screenshots at 1440 (default + glossary) and 390.

rows.name: Connected Wallets
rows.note: Linked wallets list (primary / verified / whitelisted / cooling-down badges), 'Whitelist for withdrawals' (step-up modal), error, loading and empty states. Missing: set-primary and remove/unlink (no API endpoints; unlinking a Privy wallet is the auth module's area). 'Connect a wallet' calls the auth module's openAuth('wallet') when present, otherwise it is disabled with an explanation.

rows.name: Deposit — Step 1 Select Network
rows.note: Network step: Arbitrum Sepolia live, BNB/Polygon/Ethereum/Solana 'Coming soon' and disabled; maintenance banner; first-deposit deposit-limit prompt.

rows.name: Deposit — Step 2 Select Token
rows.note: Token step: test USDT only; other tokens disabled with a warning.

rows.name: Deposit — Step 3 Deposit Address
rows.note: Address from GET /deposits/address with the client-side QR. Verified: default, wrong-network (real EIP-1193 eth_chainId check plus switch-chain button, and a dev preview), expired session (30-minute client re-check; the HD address itself is permanent). Below-minimum is only a client warning: the API credits any amount, so there is no 'held below minimum' state.

rows.name: Deposit — Step 4 QR Code
rows.note: Large QR, optional amount reminder with below-minimum error, 'waiting for your transfer' watcher (polls /deposits every 5 s), DEMO simulate control.

rows.name: Deposit — Step 5 Transaction Pending (confirmations n/N)
rows.note: Pending n/20 polled every 4 s from GET /deposits/ref/:ref: ring, segmented bar, timeline, tx hash, pending/available-after rows, DEMO 'Add 5 confirmations' and auto-advance; 'Delayed' state after 10 minutes (and via preview); advances to confirmation automatically once credited.

rows.name: Deposit — Step 6 Confirmation
rows.note: Credited confirmation with a before/after table (derived from current balances), gold open-round card (real closesAt, separate 0.05 fee line, 'You can lose your stake', 18+).

rows.name: Deposit — Step 7 Successful (receipt)
rows.note: Success receipt and failed (deposit status rejected) are done. 'Unrecognised token' cannot happen: the watcher only reads test-USDT Transfer logs.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 1 Select Asset
rows.note: USDT asset with Available balance; empty-balance state. No bonus-funds row (no bonus API).

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 2 Select Network
rows.note: Network rows with typical fees and ETA; only Arbitrum Sepolia selectable; network-match warning.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 3 Enter Address
rows.note: Whitelisted address rows or a new address with live format checks (0x, 40 hex, EIP-55), Solana-address detection (invalid state), cooldown blocking, and a new-address choice (withdraw now with manual review, or add to whitelist).

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 4 Enter Amount
rows.note: AmountInput, quick chips + MAX, limit tiles from /wallet/status, fee estimate from GET /withdrawals/quote refreshed every 15 s; below-minimum, over-balance (+ insufficient-funds modal) and limit-reached states.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 5 Fees & Summary
rows.note: Review: you-receive hero, network fee separate, platform fee 0.00, irreversibility warning, never-pre-checked confirmation box; the idempotency key is created here.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 6 Risk Validation
rows.note: Six checks from the new GET /withdrawals/precheck: pass (valid 15 min), manual review (plain reason + where the funds are), KYC required, blocked (sanctions, cooldown, balance, limit, no 2FA) with fix actions.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 7 Two-Factor Confirmation
rows.note: Authenticator code (OtpInput) sent as totpCode with POST /withdrawals; anti-phishing code shown; wrong-code (attempts left), locked and 2FA-off states mapped from STEP_UP_* errors; explicit Confirm button. Deviation: no email code (the API has none; the owner decision is TOTP + anti-phishing). Inline step as in Figma rather than the auth module's StepUpDialog.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 8 Pending
rows.note: Live polled status view. Manual review verified with WD-20931; processing and queued are code paths (queued needs four-eyes admin approval). Cancel before broadcast with confirmation. DEMO 'Simulate testnet confirmation' for queued withdrawals.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 9 Successful
rows.note: Completed view (verified with seeded WD-20877): amount received, tx hash, timeline.

rows.name: Withdraw — Step 9 Failed
rows.note: Rejected/failed views with the reason, funds returned, no fee, timeline (verified with WD-20850). The network-failure path renders from status=failed; not produced live in DEMO.

rows.name: Transaction History
rows.note: Table at 1280 and above, day-grouped cards below; 5 lifetime tiles; type chips plus status/network/date filters in the URL (bottom sheet on mobile); empty, no-results, loading and error states; pagination; CSV export of the visible page. No ID/hash search (no API parameter).

rows.name: Transaction Detail drawer
rows.note: Detail as right drawer (desktop) or bottom sheet (mobile): pending deposit with confirmations, failed withdrawal with reason, successful receipt; status timeline; tx hash (no explorer link for DEMO hashes); link to the tracker.
